label: Telekom LLM Hub
description: T-Systems LLM Hub — api key from the Hub portal.
notes: Atlas was developed and is most tested against z.ai GLM-5.2 served through this hub; every other backend here is fully supported and equally maintained.

label: OpenAI (hosted)
notes: Talks to OpenAI's Chat Completions API by default. To use the Responses API on this provider only, set ATLAS_PROVIDER_<NAME>_API=responses after setup. Atlas never guesses Responses from a model id; other backends stay on Chat Completions.

label: OpenRouter
description: openrouter.ai — OpenAI-compatible catalogue of hosted models.
notes: Model ids look like openai/gpt-4o-mini or anthropic/claude-sonnet-4, not a username or dashboard role. Use Test connection to list live ids.

label: Anthropic (OpenAI-compatible layer)
description: api.anthropic.com — Claude through Anthropic's OpenAI SDK layer.
notes: Anthropic calls this layer test-grade; for production, reach Claude through OpenRouter or the LLM Hub. reasoning_effort is ignored here, so a thinking level is sent as a thinking budget, which only Haiku 4.5 takes: the newer models refuse a budget and any temperature, Atlas stops sending one after their first refusal, and they think at their own default.

label: Z.ai (GLM)
description: api.z.ai — GLM models from Z.ai directly.
notes: GLM-5.3 cannot switch thinking off; levels are low, high and max.

label: DeepSeek
notes: Thinking is on by default. With tools the model's reasoning_content is sent back on later turns, as DeepSeek requires.

label: Google Gemini (OpenAI-compatible endpoint)
description: generativelanguage.googleapis.com — Gemini through its OpenAI endpoint.
notes: Levels are minimal, low, medium and high. Unsupported options are ignored silently rather than refused.

label: Alibaba Model Studio (Qwen)
description: DashScope compatible mode — Qwen models directly.
notes: The base URL is region-specific; take it from your Model Studio workspace. Thinking is switched with enable_thinking.

label: xAI (Grok)
notes: Levels are low, medium, high and xhigh; thinking cannot be switched off.

label: Meta Llama API
description: api.llama.com — Llama models through Meta's OpenAI-compatible path.
notes: No thinking control; the level setting is ignored.

label: Mistral
notes: Mistral takes only none and high as levels; anything else is stepped to high.

label: Ollama
description: A local Ollama server through its OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
notes: tool_choice is not supported; Atlas drops it after the first refusal.

label: Local / self-hosted (vLLM, Ollama, LM Studio, text-gen-webui, ...)
description: Any OpenAI-compatible server on your own network.
notes: API key is usually blank for a local server (leave empty).

label: Other (any OpenAI-compatible gateway)
description: Full manual control — base URL, key, model, auth style.
notes: For a non-Bearer auth header or prefix, set auth_header/auth_prefix on the SetupChoice — see core/providers.py.
